"I don't know, but I wouldn't tell you if I did.|CT-9904 "Crosshair" and this fighter|}} A [[human]] [[Gender|female]] '''fighter''' was part of [[Saw Gerrera]]'s group of [[Partisans]] stationed on [[Onderon]] at around [[19 BBY]]. While escorting a group of [[refugee]]s off Onderon, her group was [[Mission to Onderon (Elite Squad)|ambushed]] by [[Elite Squad|CT-9904's Elite Squad]], who were there to wipe out Gerrera and his Partisans. She refused to tell [[Crosshair|CT-9904]] "Crosshair" where Gerrera was and was promptly shot and [[Death|killed]] by the [[clone trooper]]. ==Biography== {{Quote|Get our people on the shuttle, now!|This fighter ordering other fighters to get the refugees on the shuttle|}} [[File:FemaleOnderonFighterArmed-TBB.png|thumb|left|270px|The fighter prepares for attack from an as-yet unknown enemy.]] This fighter was on the [[planet]] [[Onderon]] at around [[19 BBY]], helping [[Onderonian]] [[refugee]]s to get off Onderon. Hoping wipe out [[Saw Gerrera]] and his [[Partisans]], as well as to test out the newly formed [[Elite Squad]]'s loyalties, [[Governor]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]] sent [[Crosshair|CT-9904]] "Crosshair" along with troopers including [[ES-01]] and [[ES-04]] to Onderon to find and [[Death|kill]] Gerrera. The fighters were [[Mission to Onderon (Elite Squad)|ambushed]], causing the refugees to scream in fear. This fighter ordered the others to get the refugees onto a [[shuttle]]. This fighter held the troopers off and managed to board the shuttle. However, one of the troopers sniped the pilot of the shuttle, which crashed back to the ground. The door of the shuttle opened as the fighter and the refugees looked at their attackers with fear. She got off the shuttle along with the refugees and put her weapon down. Crosshair held a [[DC-17 blaster pistol]] at her chest, asking where Gerrera was. She put her hands up, claiming that she did not know where Gerrera was, telling the [[clone trooper]] that she would not tell him if she knew. Mid-sentence, Crosshair shot her in the chest, [[Death|killing]] her, remarking that he believed her as her lifeless body fell to the ground. ==Behind the scenes== This fighter first appeared in "[[Replacements]]," the third episode of the [[2021]] web-TV series ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]''. She was voiced by [[Gwendoline Yeo]], who also voiced [[Nala Se]] in the same episode. ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of unidentified female Onderonian fighter}} *{{TBB|Replacements}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=უცნობი ონდერონელი მებრძოლი ქალი }} [[Category:Females]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Onderonians]] [[Category:Partisan members]] [[Category:Resistance fighters]]
